---
title: "Country Flags"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
# Get all flag codes from the data directory
flag_files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.png$")
codes <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(flag_files)

# Pass the codes to Observable JS
ojs_define(flag_codes = codes)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Format country codes into readable names using the built-in Intl API
regionNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'], { type: 'region' });

countries = flag_codes.map(code => {
  let name;
  try {
    name = regionNames.of(code.toUpperCase()) || code.toUpperCase();
  } catch (e) {
    name = code.toUpperCase();
  }
  return { code: code, name: name };
}).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

// Dropdown input to select a country
viewof selected = Inputs.select(countries, {
  label: "Select a Country:",
  format: d => d.name,
  value: countries.find(d => d.code === "us") || countries[0]
});

// Display the selected country's flag
html`
<div style="margin-top: 20px;">
  <h3>${selected.name}</h3>
  <img 
    src="data/${selected.code}.png" 
    alt="Flag of ${selected.name}" 
    style="max-width: 600px; width: 100%; height: auto; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);" 
  />
</div>
`
```
